meta.parties: Podimahatmaya Et Al. v. Hendrick Appuhamy Et Al

rules.statement: The defendants cannot acquire prescriptive title against the plaintiffs due to insufficient evidence of possession and the limitation period not being met.
rules.supporting_quote: "There is another difficulty in the way of the defendants -setting up prescriptive title against the appellants. Even assuming that the defendants commenced their adverse possession from October, 1923, they had only five years' possession in 1928, when Philippu executed deed P 2, reserving a life-interest in his favour. Could they rely on that possession or on the adverse possession from 1928, till Philippu's death in 1932, in support of their prescriptive title?"
